You are running HEADLESS: nobody can answer you mid-run, so never wait for input. Make reasonable decisions within the brief, record them in hackathon.md, and keep going. Usage is tight: work efficiently, don't re-read large files you don't need, and commit and push after every step.

Before anything else: run `entire session current` and `entire status`. If no active session is shown, or the id is f5117257-5211-42ae-823c-32aa228a28d9, stop and print why.

Context: this continues build session B5 (906e2055), which stopped at its usage limit. It already committed and pushed:
- 7bbe5e5: evidence issues render n/a and the real porter;
- ecce3be: precedent P001 and the --continue results;
- 53346b4: NO_REACH feedback and one reach retry;
- cbb68b0: `heirloom relink`, which re-rendered the span links;
- a444c2a: precedent PRs cite their question and asking trace; replay-only rerender.

PRs #19 (84429, reused P001 without asking) and #20 (15307, asked #6) are re-rendered. The owner re-ran CVE-2026-87890 with the reach retry (`heirloom campaign --id b4-replay --continue --requeue CVE-2026-87890`). Its log is the newest ~/runs/campaign-87890-*.log.

Read ~/brief/BUILD-BRIEF.md §5 (sponsor integrations) and §10.7. Then:

0. (≤20 min) Check the 87890 re-run outcome from its log and from work/campaign/b4-replay.json.
   - If it is AFFECTED and published, verify the PR is a follow-up stacked on our 15307 branch (PR #20), or carries a dependency note on both PRs.
   - If it is UNPROVEN, check that evidence issue #10 was updated in place.
   - Record the outcome in hackathon.md, plus the "asked once" trace (#6) and the "reused without asking" trace (84429, PR #19).
   - Commit and push.
1. (≤40 min) Entire depth:
   - run `entire review` on main and `entire recap` (`entire agent-help` for flags; if one needs interaction, record that and move on), and save the outputs under docs/entire/;
   - run `entire checkpoint explain` on the runtime checkpoint of PR #13 (iamdflame/django, CVE-2026-6907, 01M4PD5ZE2YST8SFD7AMRSWCN6) and on one B5 build checkpoint (e.g. 01M4PR1YH3WPKT57E94SCTPJQ9);
   - add both to hackathon.md with what each shows.
   Commit and push.
2. (≤60 min) The four outreach drafts from §10.7 in docs/outreach/, built ONLY from artifacts that exist in this repo or on GitHub, each linking its evidence:
   - Ubuntu CVE-2026-87890:
     - use the matrix's ubuntu-noble cell and its logs;
     - use the required wording exactly;
     - state that the probe is hand-written and calibrated on Django's own fix commits (fails before dd0558d1, passes after; matrix.json records its origin);
     - include the candidate noble patch only if one exists;
     - no exploitability claim, no jammy claim.
   - Debian CVE-2026-53878: use evidence issue #3 and its provenance chain.
   - neatlogs PII DLQ: minimal repro from docs/spikes.md and hackathon.md.
   - Entire empty-repo session: "failed to get HEAD" before the first commit, from hackathon.md.
   Do not file anything; the owner files each one. Commit and push.
3. (≤60 min) Business plan with cfo.ai. Run `claude mcp list`.
   - If `cfoai` is connected:
     - Call list_orgs, then inspect_skills (list, then the build-model instructions).
     - Build Heirloom's model from measured inputs only:
       - cost and minutes per CVE from evals/results*.json and the campaign results;
       - EC2 t2.2xlarge on-demand $/hour (state the price source);
       - human minutes per escalation, from the #6 question-open to answer timestamps, labelled as one observation.
     - Buyers: distro security teams and extended-support vendors for end-of-life open-source lines.
     - Pricing: per verified backport, plus a per-package-line monthly subscription. Include base/bear/bull Scenarios, costs, revenue and runway, and label every assumption that is not measured as an assumption.
     - Publish a shared read-only Page. Write docs/business-plan.md with the link and a table of every input and its source.
   - If `cfoai` is NOT connected: write docs/business-plan.md with the measured inputs table only, and say clearly that the cfo.ai model is pending.
   Commit and push.
4. Append a dated hackathon.md entry (only things that happened), commit and push.

Budget: campaign overflow cap $18 total, provider-reported costs. No more PRs for CVE-2026-87975; never `clean --remote`. Never print .env values.

Finish with:
- `entire status`;
- `git log -5 --format='%h %s | %(trailers:key=Entire-Checkpoint,valueonly)'`;
- a final summary: files written, the cfo.ai Page link (or why there is none), the 87890 outcome, and anything you need from me.

## 5. Sponsor integrations (in the loop)

### neatlogs (agent observability)
- `pip install "neatlogs[litellm]"`. Call `neatlogs.init(api_key=env NEATLOGS_API_KEY, workflow_name="heirloom", instrumentations=["litellm"], tags=[...])` **before importing litellm**, and `neatlogs.flush(); neatlogs.shutdown()` on exit.
- **Sessions:** `with neatlogs.identify(session_id=f"campaign-{run}")` for the campaign. Each CVE gets `identify(session_id=f"cve-{id}-{run}", parent_session_id=f"campaign-{run}")`.
- **Spans:** `with neatlogs.trace("<stage>", kind="AGENT|TOOL|GUARDRAIL") as span: span.set_attribute(...)`.
  - Always set (explicit values, never missing): `heirloom.cve`, `heirloom.line`, `heirloom.stage`, `heirloom.verdict`, `heirloom.calibrated`, `heirloom.reach`, `heirloom.reason`, `heirloom.tests_edited_after_red`, `heirloom.claims_unlinked`, `heirloom.cost_usd`, `heirloom.claim_id`.
  - Wrap each `claude -p` run in an AGENT span carrying its `total_cost_usd`, `session_id` and checkpoint id (headless calls bypass the LiteLLM instrumentation).
- **Detections** (Public API `https://app.neatlogs.com/api/v1/public`, headers `Authorization: Bearer $NEATLOGS_SERVICE_TOKEN`, `x-project-id: $NEATLOGS_PROJECT_ID`, `idempotency-key`).
  - Create **conditional** detections on span attributes **before the v1 baseline runs**: `not_affected_without_calibration`, `fix_applied_where_probe_passed`, `probe_never_reached_region`, `claim_without_span`, `test_edited_after_red`.
  - Read `GET /detections/{id}/hits` and `/trends?granularity=hour` for the before/after chart. Check the conditional config syntax with `neatlogs schema search` or the docs first.
  - Backfill is not available on our tier; don't depend on it.
- **MCP:** the agent may call `search_traces` / `get_trace_context` (`https://ingest.neatlogs.com/mcp`, Bearer project key) to look up past failures of the same class (env build, flaky module) and reuse the recovery.

### Entire (agent sessions as git checkpoints)
- **Build time:** this repo has `entire enable --agent claude-code`. Use Entire deliberately and record the outputs in `hackathon.md`:
  - `entire status`, `entire checkpoint list`, `entire checkpoint explain <id>`;
  - `entire graph impact` (after `entire plugin install graph`);
  - `entire review` on a branch;
  - `entire recap`.
- **Runtime:** for each fork worktree, run `entire enable --agent claude-code --yes --local --telemetry=false`. Add `"commit_linking": "always"` to `.entire/settings.local.json`, and add `.claude/` and `.entire/` to `.git/info/exclude`.
  - After the orchestrator commits, check `git log -1 --format=%B | grep '^Entire-Checkpoint:'` and record the checkpoint id. Push the checkpoint refs with the branch. The PR links the checkpoint.
  - If trailers don't appear in headless mode, the fallback is an Agent Integration Protocol plugin `entire-agent-heirloom` (subcommands: info, detect, get-session-id, get-session-dir, resolve-session-file, read-session, write-session, read-transcript, chunk-transcript, reassemble-transcript, format-resume-command). Only if time allows.

### cfo.ai (business plan)
Done through the cfo.ai MCP in a session with that MCP connected. Inputs must be **measured**: cost per CVE from neatlogs/ledger, EC2 $/hour, human minutes per escalation.
- **Pricing hypotheses:** per verified backport, and a per-package-line monthly subscription for distro/ELTS teams.
- Scenarios base/bear/bull, a runway view, and a shared Page.
- Export a summary to `docs/business-plan.md` with the Page link.

## 6. Evals (real ground truth; numbers only from runs)
### 10.7 Outreach drafts (never filed by the agent; the human files each one)
Write drafts to `docs/outreach/`, each built only from confirmed artifacts:
- `ubuntu-cve-2026-87890.md`: Launchpad bug text for python-django (noble). Contents: facts with links, calibrated probe results, candidate patch.
- `debian-cve-2026-53878.md`: security-tracker correction proposal with the provenance proof.
- `neatlogs-pii-dlq.md`: issue with a minimal repro of large-attribute spans stalling at pii_redaction.
- `entire-empty-repo-session.md`: issue: a session started before the first commit is never tracked ("failed to get HEAD").

**Required wording for the Ubuntu draft:** "noble's CVE-2026-15307 backport leaves the bytes path that upstream closed as CVE-2026-87890; our calibrated probe shows it." No exploitability claim. No jammy claim unless a 3.2 line was actually run.
